description: This file defines the EnforcementTask class used for scheduling enforcement tasks related to entities in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.concierge.enforcement package. It includes factory methods, accessors, and a start method to initiate the enforcement task.

classes.name: EnforcementTask
classes.description: A final class representing an enforcement task that encapsulates the entity ID, a flag indicating if it changes authorization, and a supplier for executing the task asynchronously.

methods.name: EnforcementTask.of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an EnforcementTask with type safety, accepting a supplier that produces a CompletionStage parameterized with Contextual of a subtype of WithDittoHeaders.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the entity ID associated with this enforcement task.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether executing this task would modify authorization settings.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the enforcement task by invoking the supplier, returning a CompletionStage representing the asynchronous execution of the task.
